name: LeBron James
famous_for: NBA GOAT, 4x MVP, all-time scoring leader
what_if_analysis: LeBron was an All-State wide receiver. Ohio State wanted him for football. He chose basketball.
viral_angle: LeBron was so dominant in HS football that OSU's football coach begged him to play. He averaged 28 PPG in basketball WHILE being an All-State receiver.

name: Tom Brady
notable_achievements: Led team to 10-1 record senior year
what_if_analysis: Brady was drafted by the Expos in the 18th round. He chose Michigan football over pro baseball.
viral_angle: Tom Brady was drafted by MLB's Montreal Expos before he even started at Michigan. He was a lefty-hitting catcher with power.

name: Dwayne Johnson
what_if_analysis: The Rock had 9 sacks as a HS senior. A knee injury ended his NFL dreams.
viral_angle: The Rock had 9 sacks in high school and went to Miami on scholarship. A knee injury ended his NFL dream before he became the highest-paid actor ever.

name: Kyler Murray
famous_for: NFL QB, Heisman Winner, 1st overall pick
what_if_analysis: Murray went 43-0 in high school. He was drafted 9th overall by the Oakland A's before choosing football at Oklahoma.
viral_angle: Kyler Murray never lost a high school game. 43-0 as a starter. He was also a 9th-round MLB pick before winning the Heisman.

name: Terry Crews
famous_for: Actor, Old Spice Guy, Brooklyn Nine-Nine
what_if_analysis: Crews walked on at Western Michigan, got drafted, played 6 NFL seasons. Art was his backup plan.
viral_angle: Terry Crews played 6 NFL seasons before he could focus on his art. He painted his teammates' portraits to make extra money.

name: Jamie Foxx
notable_achievements: First player to pass 1,000 yards in school history
what_if_analysis: Foxx was the first QB in school history to throw for 1000 yards. He chose music over football.
viral_angle: Jamie Foxx was the first QB in his high school's history to throw for 1,000 yards. He was All-District. He chose music instead.

name: Master P
notable_achievements: Brief NBA contracts with Hornets and Raptors
what_if_analysis: Master P made NBA preseason rosters twice. He actually played in NBA games before becoming a rap mogul.
viral_angle: Master P made the Charlotte Hornets preseason roster in 1998. He got into a real NBA game before becoming a $250M rap mogul.

name: Carl Weathers
notable_achievements: Played for Raiders and BC Lions
what_if_analysis: Weathers was an All-American linebacker who played pro football for 4 years before acting.
viral_angle: Carl Weathers (Apollo Creed) played 4 years of pro football. He played for the Raiders. Then he became Rocky Balboa's greatest rival.

name: Ed O'Neill
what_if_analysis: O'Neill was signed by the Steelers in 1969. Chuck Noll cut him in training camp. He became an actor instead.
viral_angle: Ed O'Neill (Al Bundy) was signed by the Pittsburgh Steelers. Chuck Noll cut him. He walked into acting instead of walking back to football.

name: Michael Jordan
notable_achievements: Grew 4 inches between sophomore and junior year
what_if_analysis: Jordan was cut from varsity as a sophomore. He played JV, grew 4 inches, and became the greatest ever.
viral_angle: Michael Jordan was CUT from his high school varsity team as a sophomore. He used that as motivation to become the GOAT.

name: Patrick Mahomes
what_if_analysis: Mahomes threw 95 mph and had MLB interest. His dad was an MLB pitcher. He chose football instead.
viral_angle: Patrick Mahomes threw a 95 mph fastball in high school. He threw a no-hitter. His dad was an MLB pitcher. He chose football.

name: Jeff Saturday
famous_for: NFL Center, Super Bowl Champ, ESPN Analyst
notable_achievements: Undrafted to NFL Hall of Fame consideration
what_if_analysis: Saturday was a walk-on at UNC, went undrafted, and became a 6-time Pro Bowler. The ultimate underdog.
viral_angle: Jeff Saturday walked on at UNC. Went undrafted. Became Peyton Manning's center and a 6-time Pro Bowler.

name: Mahershala Ali
notable_achievements: Division I scholarship to St. Mary's
Walked on to acting after basketball
what_if_analysis: Ali played D1 basketball at St. Mary's for 4 years before switching to acting. He was an athlete first.
viral_angle: Mahershala Ali played Division I basketball for 4 years before he became a 2-time Oscar winner. He was an athlete first.

name: Mark Harmon
what_if_analysis: Harmon was a starting QB at UCLA and a Heisman candidate. His dad was a Heisman winner.
viral_angle: Mark Harmon was a starting QB at UCLA and a Heisman candidate. His dad (Tom Harmon) WON the Heisman. Football runs in the family.

name: Chadwick Boseman
what_if_analysis: Boseman played basketball and wrote his first play after a teammate was shot. Sports led him to art.
viral_angle: Chadwick Boseman wrote his first play in high school after a teammate was shot. Basketball led him to acting.

name: Jon Hamm
notable_achievements: Led team to state championship game
what_if_analysis: Hamm led his team to the state championship game. He played TE and linebacker at Texas State.
viral_angle: Jon Hamm led his high school football team to the state championship game. He played TE and linebacker at Texas State before Don Draper.

name: Paul Rudd
what_if_analysis: Rudd was a varsity wrestler who also played football and soccer. He was prom king before becoming an Avenger.
viral_angle: Paul Rudd was a varsity wrestler and Prom King before he became Ant-Man. He also played football and soccer.

name: Jason Segel
famous_for: How I Met Your Mother, Actor
what_if_analysis: Segel was 6'4 and played center on a state championship basketball team before Marshall Eriksen.
viral_angle: Jason Segel was 6'4 and won a state championship in basketball before he played Marshall in How I Met Your Mother.

name: Hilary Swank
what_if_analysis: Swank was a Junior Olympics qualifier in gymnastics. She was top 5 in Washington state before acting.
viral_angle: Hilary Swank was a Junior Olympics qualifier in gymnastics. Top 5 in Washington state. Then she became a 2-time Oscar winner.

name: Natalie Portman
what_if_analysis: Portman was on varsity track while being an Intel Science semi-finalist. Brains and athletics.
viral_angle: Natalie Portman ran varsity track while being an Intel Science Talent Search semi-finalist. She also starred in Star Wars.

name: Kate Hudson
what_if_analysis: Hudson played soccer, tennis, and was on the dance team. Athletic family (mom was Goldie Hawn).
viral_angle: Kate Hudson played soccer, tennis, and was on the dance team. Athletic talent runs in the family.

name: Joel McHale
what_if_analysis: McHale was captain of his football team and recruited to UW. He walked away from football for acting.
viral_angle: Joel McHale was captain of his football team and recruited to University of Washington. He chose comedy instead.

name: Tommy Lee Jones
famous_for: Actor, No Country For Old Men
what_if_analysis: Jones was All-State in football, went to Harvard on scholarship, and roomed with Al Gore.
viral_angle: Tommy Lee Jones was All-State in football, went to Harvard on scholarship, and was roommates with Al Gore.

name: John Goodman
what_if_analysis: Goodman was All-Conference and got a scholarship. A knee injury ended his football dreams, led to acting.
viral_angle: John Goodman was All-Conference in football and had a scholarship. A knee injury ended his career. Then he became The Dude.
